messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from the model pinning RFC — thinking out loud about a compact lease+affinity annotation to keep client payloads tiny for edge cases. TL;DR: one short token per lease vs current verbose object.
jin: +1 on wanting smaller payloads. Can you sketch the encoding?
marta: idea: single ASCII token that encodes (lease_epoch, affinity_flag, soft_ttl_hours, origin). Example: `L:20240301:A1:T24:O=controlplane` -> compressed to base36-ish `k9x4-45a`. Clients only need to send it back, servers decode.
owen: I worry about opaqueness. If a token fails decode (old server) we should degrade gracefully. Also auditability for ops.
marta: agree. Fallback plan: token -> server decodes to full metadata and emits trace span. If decode fails, treat as "unknown-lease" and fall back to our standard resolver rules. We'll add a telemetry tag for mismatches.
jin: What about security? If clients can fabricate tokens, could they trick affinity routing?
luis: We should HMAC sign the token with a short key id (kid). That keeps token short but verifiable. Example compact form: `k9x4-45a.kid7.sig` (sig truncated).
owen: Also ensure TTL semantics: soft_ttl is advisory to help caching/batching, but must not change correctness. Document that strictly.
marta: Good point; note in the plan: soft_ttl influences cache priming and batching only; hard-lease expiry still requires server-side enforcement.
infrastructure-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/lease-token-decoder v1 -> staging at 2024-10-05T16:00Z :rocket:
jin: Ops and SRE: need an emergency opt-out header (X-RW-Ignore-Compact-Lease) so we can force old behavior in incidents.
olwen: tiny nit: name wise prefer `compact-lease` over `lease-token` to reduce confusion with long-lived session tokens.
marta: Updated checklist for next steps: 1) proto + compact encoder spec, 2) HMAC scheme + key rotation plan, 3) decoder fallback semantics + telemetry, 4) clients SDK patch to emit token, 5) ops playbook + opt-out header. Anyone want to pick a task?
jin: I can own HMAC/key rotation doc.
owsen: I'll draft decoder fallback semantics and the telemetry fields.
luis: I'll prototype the compact encoder in python and generate sample tokens for perf tests.
marta: thanks — I'll open a short PR with the spec and example encodings today. :thumbsup:
jin: SGTM. One more ask: include a quick local tool to decode tokens for debugging (CLI).
marta: yup, will add `rw-decode-lease` to the dev toolkit.
owen: sounds good. If we hit edgecases during staging we'll reconvene.
infra-bot: reminder: please add the `#arch-lease-compact` label to the RFC thread for tracking.
